growth_signal.value: Raised EUR 200M in July 2026, far more than its earlier EUR 40M round; listed in VivaTech Top 100 Rising European Startups 2026.

entry.idea: Shops, restaurants and hotels struggle to plan staff shifts, so Skello makes software that builds and manages work schedules.
entry.lesson: Pick a boring daily chore in one type of business, solve it well, then use big funding to grow across Europe.
entry.name: Skello

growth.basis: substitute: EUR 200M round bigger than the EUR 40M before it
growth.reason: Funding grew from EUR 40M to EUR 200M, and the VivaTech list needs at least EUR 5M revenue and 40% yearly growth.

market.reason: Staff scheduling is needed by many businesses across Europe.

tech.reason: Scheduling software with AI features that a good team could copy in months.

entry.twist: It focuses on frontline workers and now adds AI tools to plan shifts and manage the workforce.
entry.who_pays: Businesses with hourly staff pay a subscription.
entry.why_now: Frontline businesses face staff shortages and tight rules, and new AI makes planning faster.
